author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Station v0→v4 Priority Diff (Onboarding Pilot)
abstract: Compares baseline (v0) vs latest snapshot (e.g., v4) priorities for the Onboarding Pilot. Auto-detects files in priorities directory and writes JSON/MD diff tables.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.diff_priorities import find_files, load_priorities, diff, write_outputs

base, cmpf = find_files()
if base is None or cmpf is None:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "Missing baseline or comparison file", "baseline": str(base) if base else None, "compare": str(cmpf) if cmpf else None}, indent=2))
else:
    b_pri, _ = load_priorities(base)
    c_pri, _ = load_priorities(cmpf)
    rows = diff(b_pri, c_pri)
    write_outputs(rows, base, cmpf)
    # Print top movers
    top = [r for r in rows if r["delta"] is not None]
    top = sorted(top, key=lambda r: abs(r["delta"]), reverse=True)[:5]
    print("=== Adaptive Station Priority Diff ===")
    print(json.dumps({
        "baseline": str(base),
        "compare": str(cmpf),
        "top_movers": top,
        "out_md": "storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_onboarding_v0_vs_v4_diff.md"
    }, indent=2))
